title: Chapter 613
paragraphs: Chapter 613
Episode 158. Opening Ceremony (2)
'No, what's this all of a sudden? Besides, is everyone okay with the temple floating out of nowhere?'
There was no time to think further.
Jin and Vahn's heartbeats resonated, causing a fusion of the Battle Gods, and immediately a spear flew in front of Jin's eyes.
It was Teto's spear.
'Damn, I'm late... No, I have plenty of time.'
Normally, he would have certainly been hit. Or he would have strained to deflect it and gotten injured.
But now, the spearhead flying towards his face seemed incredibly slow.
So slow that he had to make an effort to get hit!

'So that's why Battle God Brother said we should rest enough to be able to perform the Battle God Fusion before coming to the temple. The reason why the brothers showed their true killing intent as soon as the opening game started is because there is no point in showing a mediocre fighting spirit against Sister Vahn.'
There was no need to even draw a sword.
'Well, I wanted to try using the power of the Battle God Brother in real combat at least once.'
Jin threw his fist at the spearhead at a speed almost like light. From Teto's perspective, he couldn't even perceive the moment Jin moved.
Craaash-!
The strike imbued with the spirit of a Battle King and a human fist clashed, but Teto was the one who was pushed back.
No, it wasn't just being pushed back.
"Cough!"
Teto, carried by the shock transmitted through his spear, spat out a mouthful of blood and was flung far into the temple. Like an arrow or a fragment flying off when a rock breaks.
As soon as Teto flew away, all sorts of weapons flew into Jin's suddenly expanded field of view.
Swords, spears, bows, and even an unidentified net that seemed to be used for capturing giant monsters.
Feeling a thrill unknowingly at the fact that all of this was approaching with such a 'safe' feeling, Jin couldn't help but feel ecstatic.
'Was it this much...?'
He had known for a long time that Vahn's power was like a great sea.
However, wielding that power directly was literally a different dimensional experience.
Swooosh-!
With just one burst of energy, Jin was able to repel the brothers rushing at him like hungry beasts.

Baltirok's long sword, Lumora's spear, Palem's long sword, Linpa's great sword, Boras's fist and hand cannon, Dalphir's twin swords, Belliz's great sword, Garmund's great sword, Baba's long sword, Kaio's bow, Nata's kick, Teto's spear rushing back in.
And the countless weapons of the infantrymen. All these attacks could not penetrate the energy that Jin had emitted.
On the other hand, Jin was able to attack so easily. Even a strong gust of wind swept the infantrymen away like fallen leaves, and the Battle Kings gathered their energy.
The entire sky rumbled and vibrated as if it would break due to their shouts.
The atmosphere, so electric it was almost blindingly white, formed a storm-like thundercloud in an instant, and a scream-like sound of rupture poured out from the distorted space.
In a split second, a landscape that seemed to announce the end of the world unfolded.
Already, some of the ordinary warriors were seen collapsing, unable to withstand the storm of electric energy.
As naturally as if it was his own power to begin with.
Jin made sure the fallen ones were not further injured by sending electric energy near them to form a protective barrier.
He thought he could protect all the ordinary warriors like this with plenty of room to spare.
A hollow laughter came out, considering this was the power of the 'Thunder God' of the Myungwang clan.
"Kaaaaaa!"
The first Thunder King to break through Jin's electric energy and come in was Nata.
Kaio made a path by shooting an arrow, and Nata rushed in, roaring.
It was then that Jin drew his sword, Sigmund.
On the blade was an electric energy thicker than ever before. And as soon as the blade left the scabbard, Jin had one certainty.
If he wanted to, he could cut down Nata in one strike.
Of course, Jin didn't say it out loud, but Nata sensed it intuitively.
"If you were the real Thunder God brothers, you wouldn't have hesitated. Jin Brothers."
Whoosh! Electric energy swirled and gathered into Nata's fist.
'Misjudgment? No, it's a variable. Created by Nata.'
As soon as he was sure, he should have cut somewhere. Even if he did, Nata wouldn't die and would have dug one more step and thrown a punch like now.
She is a Thunder King of the Myungwang clan.
Although she is not as good as the Thunder God, she is not someone who can be defeated with a single stroke.
Even if it were the real Vahn, they would have to give it their all to kill them. Especially in a situation where all twelve Thunder Kings and all ordinary warriors are attacking at once.
Nata's fist passed by Jin's ear. He lost his sense of balance for a moment due to the shockwave, but it was not enough to hinder his counterattack.
He parried the punch with his sword hilt and unfolded a series of attacks.
As Nata's blood evaporated in the electric energy, the great sword of Belliz, the second to step in, flew in.

He dodged and stabbed, repelled Kaio's electric attack, twisted the attack trajectories of Palem and Lumora, pushed Baltirok away, knocked down Dalphir and Garmund, repelled Linpa, punched Boras in the jaw (at this point, he adjusted his strength thinking Boras would be busy later), and struck down Teto's spear.
All of this took 3 seconds.
Jin had not yet been hit effectively, and instead, he was about to counterattack while their formation was broken.
But there was one person left.
Baba, the old Thunder King, the direct descendant of the old Thunder God Nana. Her blue blade was rushing through the chaotic battlefield.
'This is dangerous.'
A chill ran up his neck with intuition. A sense of crisis that seemed impossible to feel in a combined state of Godliness instantly woke him up.
The perfect solution to this crisis is to perfectly parry the attack.
The eyes and senses of the god, even in such a desperate situation, allowed him to swing his sword without wavering.
However, if he parries this, Baba will die or be crippled.
If it wasn't for Nata's case earlier, Jin would have hesitated again. They are not enemies, but brothers in competition.
'Half-hearted response for fear of Baba getting hurt is, in fact, an insult to the brothers.'
As if a lie, Jin's lightning energy, spread all around, gathered into Sigmund before he could even blink.
Before their sword tips touched, all of Jin's strength was focused on the apex of his blade for an extremely short moment.
Krung...!
Baba's sword distorted. Her arm holding the sword twisted, and Jin did not stop even after seeing that.
A shockwave that seemed to completely destroy the main hall spread out.
The nearby god-kings were knocked away indiscriminately, and Jin did not recover his released power.

Rather, he amplified it further. With the intention of annihilating all the god-kings. The explosion dyed the field of vision all white, and due to the shock being too great, even the senses of the god couldn't immediately grasp the situation.
And the thing Jin regretted didn't happen.
Through the great explosion, he saw Baba's sword, like lightning, falling again. Baba's sword threatening him again as it tore through the white storm of lightning energy.
It wasn't as threatening as the first time.
Jin leisurely deflected Baba's sword and knocked her to the ground without giving her a chance to get up. He rushed at her like a beast, aiming his sword at her neck.
Just before he stabbed, Kaio's arrow pushed Sigmund away.
The combined attacks of the god-kings, one after another, were even more ferocious.
In addition, some of the warriors were finally following the path the god-kings had opened and were entering.
In that moment, Jin couldn't help but have a look of ecstasy once again.
The fact that he could be in such a 'boring' situation even after unleashing the god's unification, and the fact that these stubborn and strong warriors were his brothers, struck his heart.
The emotion Jin was feeling was a pride as the greatest warrior race in history.
"Guard the Twelve Kings!"
"Don't confront him one-on-one, he's coming!"
"God-King Baba needs time to recover!"
As the fight went on, one by one, bruises began to appear on Jin's body. The other Demon Kings had broken bones and torn muscles, but their momentum didn't falter at all.
Rather, they were becoming more ferocious. It would have been impossible alone, but for the Demon Kings who were cooperating, individual injuries were not a problem.

They were moving as one, not distinguishing between the Fighting Kings and the ordinary warriors. There was not an absolute absence of differences according to the rank of the warriors, but anyone could become the center of the attack when the opportunity arose.
Jin charged recklessly, disrupting their formation.
However, no matter how much he broke them down, the brothers showed no signs of collapsing.
Vahn watched them fight from the sky (riding on the back of Lingling, who had transformed her size), with satisfaction.
[Hmm... Seeing him fight so well is annoying. He's already strong, and with Vahn's power added, he's just flying.]
"Lingling, why do you act like that when you don't really hate Jin?"
[Why do you ask, Vahn, when you already know what I'm thinking?]
"I see."
[...More importantly, are you really okay with giving him all your power?]
With a soft laugh, Vahn smiled.
"I'm ready to give everything I have not only to Jin, but to all my brothers at any time."
[Che, how can you say that with a straight face, Vahn?]
"And the same goes for you, Lingling. You're not my brother, but you've become a part of me. No, you've become family."
Lingling didn't respond, instead flapping her wings rapidly, as if embarrassed.
Vahn sighed as if tired.
It was time for the unification with the Fighting Spirit to end.
Having been at full strength for the past 10 minutes, his current state was causing even greater fatigue.
The moment the fight was over.
Jin, gasping for breath, had his blade against Baba's throat, and the Fighting Kings had their weapons pointed at him.
Initially, Jin was overpowering, but as the coordination of the unification with the Fighting Spirit decreased, he gradually began to be pushed back.
The Ming Dynasty stopped all attacks as soon as the unification with the Fighting Spirit ended.
It had been a short battle, not even 10 minutes long, but Jin and the rest of the Ming Dynasty looked as if they had been living on a battlefield for days.
"You're strong, Brother Jin!"
"Strong? If it weren't for Sister Vahn's power, it would have been over in no time."
"That's obvious. Anyway, it was a fun fight!"
As always, whenever Jin achieved a 'feat', the Ming Dynasty opened their mouths towards the empty space in the hall.
Then they swallowed the air greedily, like young animals trying to eat falling snow.
It was a bit embarrassing, but Jin laughed at the sight of his brothers, who had become so innocently happy.
"Well done. Let's conclude the opening match of the Fighting Kings' tournament with this."
